Hawaii Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Vacation Itinerary (June 10-20, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen
- Hiking gear
- Casual outfits
- Camera
- Travel documents

Activity-Specific Items:
- Beach day at Waikiki Beach: Beach towel, flip flops, sunglasses
- Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay: Snorkel gear, water shoes, rash guard
- Hiking at Diamond Head: Hiking boots, water bottle, hat
- Visit to Pearl Harbor: Comfortable walking shoes, light jacket
- Road trip to North Shore: Snacks, music playlist, GPS device
- Luau experience: Semi-formoutfit, camera for photos
- Hotel spa day: Robe, slippers, book
- Kayaking at Kailua Beach: Quick-dry clothes, waterproof bag
- Shopping at Ala Moana Center: Comfortable shoes, reusable shopping bag
